## 

1.  Load libraries

    ```{r}
    library(tidyverse)
    library(broom)
    library(purrr)
    library(ggrepel)
    ```

2.  Load datasets

    ```{r}
    metadata <- read_csv("data/metadata.csv")
    counts <- read_csv("data/counts.csv")
    ```

3.  Convert counts into long format

    ```{r}
    counts_long <- counts |>
      pivot_longer(
        cols = -gene_id,
        names_to = "sample_id",
        values_to = "count"
      )
    ```

4.  Joins count with metadata

    ```{r}
    counts_aug <- counts_long |>
      left_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")
    ```

5.  Checking any missing value

    ```{r}
    counts_aug |>
      summarise(
        total_samples = n_distinct(sample_id),
        missing_stimulus = sum(is.na(stimulus)),
        missing_time = sum(is.na(time)),
        missing_donor = sum(is.na(donor))
      )
    ```

6.  Set factors levels

    The order of factor levels determines the reference category in many statistical models.

    ```{r}
    counts_aug <- counts_aug |>
      mutate(
        stimulus = factor(
          stimulus,
          levels = c(
            "Control_group",
            "C_albicans",
            "A_fumigatus",
            "R_oryzae"
          )
        ),
        time = factor(
          time,
          levels = c("4h", "24h")
        ),
        donor = factor(donor)
      )
    ```

7.  Calculate total reads, CPM and log2(CPM + 1)

    CPM means Counts Per Million. Normalizes raw gene counts by the total number of reads in each sample, making expression values comparable across samples with different sequencing depths.

    log2(cpm+1) **:** Applies a log transformation to normalized expression values to reduce skewness, lessen the influence of highly expressed genes, and handle zero counts safely.

    ```{r}
    counts_aug <- counts_aug |>
      group_by(sample_id) |>
      mutate(
        total_reads = sum(count),
        cpm = count / total_reads * 1e6,
        log_cpm = log2(cpm + 1)
      ) |>
      ungroup()
    ```

8.  Check CPM normalisation

    ```{r}
    cpm_check <- counts_aug |>
      group_by(sample_id) |>
      summarise(
        total_cpm = sum(cpm),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    cpm_check
    ```

9.  Filter lower expressed genes

    Keeping the genes thta have at least 10 reads in at least 8 samples.

    ```{r}
    counts_aug <- counts_aug |>
      group_by(gene_id) |>
      filter(sum(count >= 10) >= 8) |>
      ungroup()
    ```

10. After filtering, how many genes remain

    ```{r}
    counts_aug |>
      summarise(number_of_genes = n_distinct(gene_id))
    ```

11. Select only R.Oryzae and control

    ```{r}
    counts_oryzae <- counts_aug |>
      filter(
        stimulus %in% c("Control_group",
                        "R_oryzae")
      )
    ```

    ```{r}
    counts_oryzae |>
      distinct(sample_id, time, stimulus, donor) |>
      count(time, stimulus)
    ```

12. Check donor matching

    ```{r}
    donor_check <- counts_oryzae |>
      distinct(donor, time, stimulus) |>
      mutate(value = 1) |>
      pivot_wider(
        names_from = stimulus,
        values_from = value,
        values_fill = 0
      )
    nrow(donor_check)

    ```

13. Removing missing donor

    Because one donor lacked a matching sample in the R. Oryzae group, only complete donor pairs were kept to avoid introducing noise and to ensure accurate donor-matched comparisons in the statistical model.

    ```{r}
    complete_donors <- donor_check |>
      filter(
        Control_group == 1,
        R_oryzae == 1
      ) |>
      select(donor, time)

    counts_oryzae <- counts_oryzae |>
      semi_join(
        complete_donors,
        by = c("time", "donor")
      )
    ```

14. Prepare data for modelling

    ```{r}
    counts_aug_long <- counts_oryzae |>
      select(
        gene_id,
        sample_id,
        donor,
        time,
        stimulus,
        log_cpm
      )
    ```

15. Nest data by gene and time

    ```{r}
    counts_aug_long_nested <- counts_aug_long |>
      group_by(gene_id, time) |>
      nest() |>
      ungroup()

    counts_aug_long_nested
    ```

16. Fit linear models

    ```{r}
    counts_aug_long_nested <- counts_aug_long_nested |>
      mutate(
        model_object = map(
          .x = data,
          .f = ~ lm(
            formula = log_cpm ~ donor + stimulus,
            data = .x
          )
        )
      )
    ```

We fit one model for each gene at 4h and another at 24h. The model accounts for baseline differences between donors while testing the effect of the stimulus on gene expression.

17. Extract model estimates

    ```{r}
    counts_aug_long_nested <- counts_aug_long_nested |>
      mutate(
        model_object_tidy = map(
          .x = model_object,
          .f = ~ tidy(
            x = .x,
            conf.int = TRUE,
            conf.level = 0.95
          )
        )
      )
    ```

18. Combine model results

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates <- counts_aug_long_nested |>
      unnest(model_object_tidy)
    ```

19. Add gene symbols for the four marker genes

    ```{r}
    marker_genes <- tibble(
      gene_id = c(
        "ENSG00000169429",
        "ENSG00000125538",
        "ENSG00000136244",
        "ENSG00000232810"
      ),
      gene_symbol = c(
        "CXCL8",
        "IL1B",
        "IL6",
        "TNF"
      )
    )

    ```

20. Add gene symbols to the gene estimates

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates <- gene_estimates |>
      left_join(marker_genes, by = "gene_id")
    ```

21. Select the R. oryzae effect

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates <- gene_estimates |>
      filter(term == "stimulusR_oryzae") |>
      select(
        gene_id,
        gene_symbol,
        time,
        p.value,
        estimate,
        conf.low,
        conf.high
      ) |>
      ungroup()
    ```

22. Adjust p-values and identify differentially expressed genes

    P-values were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg method to control the false discovery rate arising from thousands of simultaneous gene-level tests. And genes with q.value \< 0.05 and an absolute estimate \> 1 were classified as differentially expressed, while all others were considered not significant..

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates <- gene_estimates |>
      group_by(time) |>
      mutate(
        q.value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"),
        expression = case_when(
          q.value < 0.05 & estimate > 1 ~ "Upregulated",
          q.value < 0.05 & estimate < -1 ~ "Downregulated",
          TRUE ~ "Not significant"
        )
      ) |>
      ungroup()
    ```

23. Count significant genes:

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates |>
      count(time, expression)
    ```

24. Check number of gene estimates

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates |>
      count(time)
    ```

25. Check missing p-values

    ```{r}
    gene_estimates |>
      summarise(
        total_genes = n(),
        missing_estimates = sum(is.na(estimate)),
        missing_pvalues = sum(is.na(p.value))
      )
    ```

26. Volcanno plot of gene expression for 4h

    ```{r}

    ggplot(
      gene_estimates |> filter(time == "4h"),
      aes(
        x = estimate,
        y = -log10(q.value),
        color = expression
      )
    ) +


      geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +

      
      scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "Upregulated" = "red",
        "Downregulated" = "blue",
        "Not significant" = "grey"
      )) +

      # Highlight the four marker genes
      geom_point(
        data = gene_estimates |>
          filter(time == "4h", !is.na(gene_symbol)),
        aes(x = estimate, y = -log10(q.value)),
        fill = "yellow",
        colour = "black",
        shape = 21,
        size = 2.5,
        stroke = 0.8
      ) +

      # Add gene names
      geom_text_repel(
        data = gene_estimates |>
          filter(time == "4h", !is.na(gene_symbol)),
        aes(
          x = estimate,
          y = -log10(q.value),
          label = gene_symbol
        ),
        color = "black",
        size = 3,
        fontface = "bold",
        max.overlaps = Inf
      ) +

      
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = c(-1, 1),
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +

      geom_hline(
        yintercept = -log10(0.05),
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +

      labs(
        title = "Volcano plot: R. oryzae vs Control (4h)",
        x = "Estimated difference in log2 CPM",
        y = "-log10 Adjusted p-value",
        color = "Expression"
      ) +

      theme_minimal()

    ```
